Skips 10.x / 192.168.x / 172.x / 127.0.0.1 / empty IPs
✅ EXTERNAL IP

HTTP — GET AbuseIPDB

score ≥ 50 → Branch A (block) | 20–49 → Branch B (rate-limit) | < 20 → Branch C (alert only)

ssh/smtp → WF-2 | ddos/dos → WF-3 | web/sqli/xss → WF-4 | correlation/apt → WF-5

Branch C (alert only)
